title: Ask for the microphone only when the owner holds to speak
requested_outcome: On the owner's iPhone the browser keeps showing 'Would like to access the microphone' while he is only reading, for example on the orders screen. Cause, in crooks-assistant/web/app.js: warmMic() opens the microphone on the first pointerdown anywhere on the page, on every visibilitychange back to visible, and after every reconnect, while the page releases the stream whenever it is hidden; on iOS a home-screen web app asks again each time the stream is reopened and the microphone permission query is not reliable there. Change it so the microphone is requested only by the owner's hold-to-speak press, never by any other touch, by returning to the app or by reconnecting; once granted in a session, reuse the one live stream for later presses; keep the existing Android behaviour of forgetting an ended track; keep warming on load only where the permission query positively reports granted. Apply the same rule in web/alpha.js if it opens the microphone. Add a node test under tests/web (using the existing dom-shim) proving that a tap elsewhere, a visibility return and a reconnect never call getUserMedia, and that two presses share one stream. The previous attempt (branch clive/objective/microphone-prompt-fix-2) found that tests/test_web.py line 253 pins the old microphone-test handler (`const stream = await ensureMicStream();` after `el.micTest.addEventListener`). tests/test_web.py is now in scope for that assertion only: the microphone test must reuse a live stream when micIsLive() and otherwise tell the owner to hold to speak first, never opening the microphone itself; update that one assertion to state the new behaviour and change nothing else in the file. Reuse the previous attempt where it is sound. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: getUserMedia is reached only from the hold-to-speak press path
a tap elsewhere, a return to the app and a reconnect never request the microphone, proven by a node test
a granted stream is reused for later presses in the same session
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
